record.description: A floating de-icer for stock tanks that keeps a patch of water open in winter. It draws 1,250 watts and switches on only when the temperature calls for it. The cast aluminum body is built to last, and the cord has a protective guard.

The fit is tailored to flatter a range of body types, and the jacket is offered in sizes from XS to 3X. This pair is sized XL in black, a classic color that pairs easily with most scrub pants. The design includes fashionable features such as clean lines and thoughtful stitching, which the seller says give the jacket a professional appearance. Scrub garments are often washed frequently, so check the care label and wash in cool water to keep the knit from losing its shape. Choosing the right size can help the jacket move comfortably with the wearer throughout the day.

record.description: Men's six-inch waterproof motorcycle boots in black, with a full-grain leather upper and ankle padding. The lining uses a breathable waterproof membrane, and the rubber outsole resists abrasion. The boot is sized 11.5.
record.seo_title: Harley-Davidson Men's Holtman Boots Black 11.5
record.meta_description: Harley-Davidson men's Holtman 6-inch waterproof motorcycle boots in black, size 11.5, with full-grain leather upper and breathable waterproof lining.
record.long_description: The Holtman is a men's motorcycle boot built to handle weather and daily wear. Its six-inch shaft and one-inch heel give a classic riding profile while keeping the fit practical for walking. The upper is full-grain leather with ankle padding that adds comfort around the lower leg. A Hydro-Guard waterproof membrane lines the boot to keep moisture out, and it is designed to breathe so the foot does not overheat. The cement construction and lightweight rubber outsole give the boot a flexible feel, while the abrasion resistant overlays protect the sole where it meets the ground. The black color is versatile for riding gear or everyday wear. This pair is sized 11.5. Riders who expect long miles should break the boots in gradually and check the fit before a long trip, since leather takes time to conform to the foot.

record.description: A pack of ten brushed brass drawer pulls with 4-inch hole spacing and a stainless steel build. The handles measure about 6-2/5 inches long and come with screws for installation. They suit kitchen and bathroom cabinets.
record.seo_title: goldenwarm Brushed Brass Drawer Pulls 10 Pack
record.meta_description: goldenwarm 10-pack brushed brass cabinet pulls with 4-inch hole centers and stainless steel build. Includes screws and suits kitchen and bath cabinets.
record.long_description: This ten pack of cabinet pulls gives a cabinet refresh a coordinated look with a brushed brass finish. Each pull is made from stainless steel and spans about 4 inches between mounting holes, a standard spacing that suits many drawers. The handles measure roughly 162 millimeters long, with a projection of about 32 millimeters from the surface to the bar. The package includes screws in two sizes so installers can match the pull to the thickness of the door or drawer. The listing describes the handles as high quality with a smooth surface and easy installation. They work for kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and dressers. Before drilling, mark the hole positions with a template so the pulls line up evenly across the front of each drawer. Clean the finish with a soft cloth and mild soap to keep the brass tone bright.

record.description: A funny anniversary greeting card with an otter theme, meant for married couples. The thick card stock includes recycled content and is printed in the USA and Canada. The inside gives a humorous, romantic message.
record.seo_title: NobleWorks Significant Otters Anniversary Card
record.meta_description: NobleWorks funny anniversary card with a romantic otter theme for married couples. Thick recycled cardstock, made in the USA and Canada.
record.long_description: This anniversary card puts a playful spin on romance with a pair of otters and a humorous message for a spouse. The cover is printed on thick cardstock that includes about 30 percent recycled content, which appeals to buyers who want a more sustainable card. The company notes that the cards are made in the USA and Canada with print on demand technology. The cover page is slightly longer than the back for easy opening, an intentional design detail. The card is suited to couples with a sense of humor who prefer a light, teasing tone to a sentimental one. It works for anniversaries, Valentine's Day, or a simple just-because note. Its size fits standard envelopes, so it is easy to mail or to tuck into a gift box with a small present.

record.description: A 500 ml bottle of liquid cod liver oil with a lemon flavor. One teaspoon supplies 1,100 mg of omega-3s, including EPA and DHA. The oil comes from wild-caught Arctic cod livers and is managed closely from sea to store.
record.seo_title: Carlson Lemon Cod Liver Oil 500 ml 1100 mg Omega-3
record.meta_description: Carlson lemon cod liver oil, 500 ml liquid, with 1,100 mg omega-3s per teaspoon including EPA and DHA from wild-caught Norwegian cod.
record.long_description: Carlson's cod liver oil is a liquid supplement made from wild-caught Norwegian Arctic cod livers. A single teaspoon provides 1,100 milligrams of omega-3 fatty acids, including EPA and DHA, which the brand links to heart, brain, vision, and joint health. The lemon flavor is designed to make the daily dose easier to take than plain fish oil. The bottle holds 500 milliliters, enough for many weeks of use at the suggested serving. The company states that the oil is closely managed from the sea to the store to keep it fresh. Carlson also points to its award-winning taste and quality. As with any supplement, check the label for dosing guidance and talk with a health professional about whether it fits your needs, particularly if you take blood thinners or have a fish allergy. Store the bottle in a cool place and refrigerate after opening if the label recommends it.

record.description: A bamboo knee compression sleeve for runners, hikers, and gym users who want added support. It is designed to help with joint comfort and circulation during activity. The medium gray sleeve also suits recovery after an injury.
record.seo_title: ProFitness Bamboo Knee Sleeve Medium Gray
record.meta_description: ProFitness bamboo knee compression sleeve in medium gray for running, hiking, and workouts. Offers knee support and suits recovery after injury.
record.long_description: The ProFitness bamboo knee sleeve is a compression garment built for people who run, hike, walk, or lift and want steady support around the knee. Its bamboo fabric is chosen for softness and breathability, which keeps the sleeve comfortable during long sessions. The compression fit is intended to ease joint discomfort and support circulation, and the listing says the sleeve can help during recovery after surgery. A medium gray color keeps the sleeve neutral for everyday wear. The sleeve is designed to stay in place without bunching, so the wearer can move freely through a workout. Choose the size from the chart by measuring around the knee, since a sleeve that is too tight can restrict blood flow. If pain persists or worsens, consult a health care professional before continuing a regular routine with the sleeve.

record.description: Ninety chewable vitamin C tablets at 500 mg each, in a cran-raspberry flavor. Vitamin C supports the immune system and acts as an antioxidant. The tablets are vegan, gluten free, kosher, and non-GMO.
record.seo_title: Solgar Chewable Vitamin C 500 mg 90 Tablets
record.meta_description: Solgar chewable vitamin C 500 mg, 90 cran-raspberry tablets. Vegan, gluten free, kosher, and non-GMO for immune and antioxidant support.
record.long_description: Solgar's chewable vitamin C tablets deliver 500 milligrams of the vitamin per tablet in a cran-raspberry flavor that makes a daily routine easy to keep. The bottle holds 90 tablets, which the brand counts as 90 servings for one tablet per day. The product is positioned to support immune health, since vitamin C plays a role in how white blood cells function. It also acts as an antioxidant that helps address the effects of free radicals on cells. The tablets are vegan, gluten free, kosher, and non-GMO, which suits a range of dietary preferences. Solgar has been making supplements for more than seventy years, according to the listing. Chew each tablet fully before swallowing. Vitamin C is water soluble, so intake from all sources matters, and the label's maximum dose guidance should be followed. Consult a healthcare provider before starting a new supplement, especially if taking other medications.

record.description: High-waisted black leggings for yoga, running, and daily workouts. A hidden waistband pocket holds a key or card. Seamless construction and a gusset crotch allow free movement and reduce chafing.
record.seo_title: BALEAF Women's High Waisted Leggings Black M
record.meta_description: BALEAF women's high-waisted black leggings in size M with tummy control, hidden pocket, and moisture-wicking stretch for yoga and running.
record.long_description: These high-waisted leggings are built for yoga, running, gym sessions, and casual wear. The wide, high-rise waistband offers a smooth, supportive fit through the midsection and extends coverage to reduce a muffin top. A hidden pocket in the waistband holds a key, card, or phone without bouncing during movement. The fabric is moisture-wicking and stretchy, drawing sweat away from the skin to keep the wearer comfortable during longer efforts. A gusset in the crotch allows free motion, and interlocking seams are meant to minimize rubbing and chafing during repetitive exercise. The black color is versatile and hides everyday wear. Leggings of this type are sized carefully, so consult the size chart and choose a pair that stays in place when squatting or stretching.

record.description: A 4-foot by 50-foot black landscape fabric that blocks light to suppress weeds. The non-woven, treated material lets air and water pass through and resists UV degradation. The listing rates it for twelve years of use.
record.seo_title: Dewitt 12-Year Weed Barrier Fabric 4x50 ft Black
record.meta_description: Dewitt 4-foot by 50-foot black 12-year weed barrier fabric. Non-woven, UV-treated landscape fabric that blocks light and lets water pass through.
record.long_description: Dewitt's 12-year weed barrier is a black landscape fabric that blocks sunlight from reaching the soil, which helps suppress weed growth in beds, paths, and under mulch. The roll measures 4 feet by 50 feet, enough to cover a sizable garden area in one or two runs. The non-woven fabric is treated to resist degradation from ultraviolet light, which the brand says supports its long-term rating. Because the material is hydrophilic, water and air can pass through it, so the soil underneath stays healthy and moist. The fabric is designed to resist unraveling and to be easy to cut with scissors or a utility knife. Anchor the edges with landscape pins and overlap seams so light cannot get through the gaps. Plant through pre-cut holes or cut an X where a plant needs to go, and cover the fabric with mulch to extend its life.

record.description: A 25-liter backpack with a front pocket that organizes electronics and small accessories. The back is two-thirds padded for comfort. It measures about 12 inches wide at the bottom, 11 in the middle, and 10 at the top.
record.seo_title: JanSport SuperBreak Backpack 25 Liter
record.meta_description: JanSport SuperBreak backpack with 25-liter capacity, front organizer pocket, and a two-thirds padded back. A daily carry for school or work.
record.long_description: The SuperBreak backpack gives everyday carriers a 25-liter main compartment that fits books, a laptop sleeve, or a lunch with room to spare. A front organizer pocket keeps electronics, chargers, and small accessories sorted so they are easy to find. The back panel is two-thirds padded, which spreads weight across the shoulders and makes the pack more comfortable on long walks between classes or meetings. The bag measures about 12 inches wide at the bottom, 11 inches in the middle, and 10 inches at the top, with a depth of about 5 inches. Its tapered shape keeps the load closer to the back. The listing shows a cupcake-themed pattern, which gives the pack a playful look for younger students or fans of the design. Load heavier items near the back and close to the spine to keep the bag balanced and comfortable.

record.description: A white magnetic screen door that lets people and pets walk through hands-free and closes again on its own. It fits doors up to 38 by 82 inches and includes a hook-and-loop installation kit. The heavy duty mesh curtain stays in place.
record.seo_title: innotree White Magnetic Screen Door 36 Magnets
record.meta_description: innotree white magnetic screen door with 36 magnets, fits doors up to 38 by 82 inches. Hands-free pass-through for people and pets, with hook-and-loop install.
record.long_description: This magnetic screen door gives a home an easy-to-use mesh barrier for fresh air and open doorways. The curtain is held together by 36 magnets, so it parts when someone walks through and closes behind them without a latch. The mesh is described as heavy duty and is sized for doors up to 38 by 82 inches. The kit includes a complete assembly set with step-by-step instructions and a hook-and-loop system that attaches the frame to the door frame. The listing advises cleaning the frame before installation, since dust and powder can prevent the adhesive from holding. The white color blends with most door frames. Households with dogs and cats often choose this type of screen because pets can pass through, though owners should watch for pets that may push the mesh aggressively. Test the fit before tightening all the hook-and-loop strips.

record.description: A black trail gear holder that clips to a saddle and carries a water bottle. An elastic opening grips the bottle firmly, while a hook-and-loop front pocket gives quick access to small items. Reflective accents on the pocket add visibility.
record.seo_title: Weaver Leather Trail Water Bottle Holder Black
record.meta_description: Weaver Leather black trail gear water bottle holder with elastic grip, hook-and-loop front pocket, and reflective accents. Attaches easily to a saddle.
record.long_description: This trail gear holder is made to carry a water bottle on horseback or on another saddle-based outing. Its elastic opening grips the bottle securely so it stays put on rough ground, and the design is easy to slip a bottle in and out of. A hook-and-loop front pocket gives quick access to small items such as a phone, snacks, or a map, without needing to dismount. The holder attaches to a saddle through a simple strap arrangement that the listing describes as easy to fit. Reflective accents on the front pocket help the rider stay visible in low light, a useful feature for early morning or late day trail rides. The black color blends with most tack and works with a range of saddles. Check the fit with the bottle you plan to carry before heading out, and test the attachment before a longer ride.

record.description: A women's faux fur jacket with a leopard print in pink, sized large. It has pocket flaps and a button closure. The soft faux fur gives the jacket a bold, fashionable look for cooler days.
record.seo_title: Steve Madden Women's Leopard Faux Fur Jacket L
record.meta_description: Steve Madden women's pink leopard print faux fur jacket in size large. Button closure, pocket flaps, and soft faux fur for cooler days.
record.long_description: This women's jacket uses a leopard print on soft faux fur for a bold look that stands out in a casual or evening outfit. The pink leopard colorway adds a playful twist to the classic animal pattern. A button closure fastens the front, and pocket flaps add a tailored detail to the sides. The faux fur is described as soft and comfortable, giving the jacket a plush texture that works well over sweaters and tops. Sized large, the jacket is meant to be worn with a little room for layering. Steve Madden is known for footwear and accessories, and this jacket brings the same attention to styling to outerwear. Faux fur can shed or flatten when rubbed, so brushing it gently and storing it on a hanger helps it keep its shape. Pair the jacket with jeans, black pants, or a simple dress for a statement piece.

record.description: A 21-inch plush flamingo from Jellycat, suitable from birth. It can be hand washed, and the listing advises spot cleaning only. The soft stuffed animal is made for gifting and early play.
record.seo_title: Jellycat Mad Pet Flora Flamingo Plush 21 Inch
record.meta_description: Jellycat Mad Pet Flora flamingo stuffed animal, 21 inches, soft plush suitable from birth. Hand washable, spot clean only, and made for gifting.
record.long_description: The Mad Pet Flora flamingo is a 21-inch plush from Jellycat, a brand known for soft, character-driven stuffed animals. The toy is listed as suitable from birth, which makes it a thoughtful gift for a newborn or a baby shower. Its soft plush body is designed for cuddling in a crib, stroller, or car seat. Care instructions say the toy is hand washable, and the listing advises spot cleaning as the preferred method to protect the stitching and the fabric. A flamingo design adds a bright, whimsical touch to a nursery shelf or a child's bed. The toy also suits toddlers who like to carry a favorite companion everywhere. Because plush toys can attract dust, air the toy regularly and clean it gently when it becomes soiled. Check the toy for loose parts before giving it to a young child.

record.description: A quiet white wireless mouse that connects through a small 2.4G USB receiver. It needs no drivers and works with PCs, tablets, and laptops. The listing gives a range of about 33 feet and a risk-free warranty.
record.seo_title: seenda Pure White Wireless Mouse 2.4G Quiet
record.meta_description: seenda pure white wireless mouse with 2.4G USB receiver, noiseless clicks, and plug-and-play setup for PCs, tablets, and laptops. Range up to 33 feet.
record.long_description: This wireless mouse uses a 2.4 gigahertz connection and a small USB receiver that stays plugged into the computer. Its noiseless clicking design suits quiet offices, libraries, and shared spaces where the sound of a standard mouse can be distracting. The mouse works through plug and play setup, so there are no drivers to install before it is ready to use. The listing lists a working range of up to about 33 feet, enough to use it comfortably from a sofa or a desk across the room. It is compatible with PCs, tablets, and laptops that have a USB port. The pure white color matches many modern computer setups. The seller offers a lifetime risk-free warranty that promises a money back or a replacement if a product arrives defective or raises a question. Keep the receiver stored inside the mouse when traveling to avoid losing it.

record.description: A countertop cotton candy machine rated at 450 watts that heats up in about five minutes. It comes with ten wooden sticks and a suction-cup base that detaches for cleaning. It suits both kids and adults.
record.seo_title: Chef Buddy Countertop Cotton Candy Machine
record.meta_description: Chef Buddy countertop cotton candy machine, 450 watts, heats up in about five minutes. Includes 10 wooden sticks and a detachable base for cleaning.
record.long_description: The Chef Buddy cotton candy machine is a compact countertop appliance for making spun sugar treats at parties, birthdays, and family gatherings. It operates on 120 volts at 450 watts and heats up in about five minutes, so guests do not wait long for the first batch. The package includes ten wooden sticks for serving and a suction cup base that detaches to make cleaning easier. The machine measures about 9.25 inches high, 10.5 inches wide, and 10.5 inches deep, a footprint that fits on most kitchen counters. A 40-inch two-prong cord reaches standard outlets. The listing describes the machine as fun for both kids and adults. Keep children away from the heating element while it is running, and unplug the machine after use. Allow the head to cool before disassembling for cleaning.

record.description: A ready-to-hang canvas print of Van Gogh's almond blossom painting, sized 16 by 12 inches. It reproduces the floral oil painting in a modern framed style. The print suits bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and offices.
record.seo_title: Wieco Art Van Gogh Almond Blossom Canvas Print
record.meta_description: Wieco Art Van Gogh almond blossom giclee canvas print, 16 by 12 inches, ready to hang with a modern framed style for bedrooms and living rooms.
record.long_description: This giclee canvas print reproduces Vincent van Gogh's famous almond blossom painting, a floral subject that brings soft spring color into an interior space. The image is printed on canvas and comes ready to hang, so buyers do not need to add a frame. It measures 16 by 12 inches, a size that suits a bedroom wall, a small dining area, a hallway, or a home office. The listing describes a modern framed presentation that fits contemporary decor. Because the print shows painted color, it is best viewed in natural light to appreciate the brushwork. The listing notes that color can vary slightly depending on the monitor used to view the image, so the actual print may look a little different from the photo. Hang the print with the hardware supplied, and keep it out of direct sunlight to slow fading over time.

record.description: A black magnetic folio case for the iPad Pro 11-inch second generation released in 2020. It offers six viewing angles, auto sleep and wake, and a pencil holder. The cover supports wireless charging for the Apple Pencil.
record.seo_title: Ztotop iPad Pro 11 2nd Gen 2020 Case Black
record.meta_description: Ztotop black magnetic case for iPad Pro 11-inch 2nd generation (2020). Six viewing angles, auto sleep and wake, and a pencil holder.
record.long_description: This folio case is made for the iPad Pro 11-inch second generation released in 2020, and the listing lists compatible model numbers for that tablet. The strong magnetic closure keeps the cover shut and wakes or sleeps the screen automatically when opened or closed. A magnetic stand provides six viewing angles, which suits watching video, typing, or sketching on the tablet. A pencil holder on the case keeps an Apple Pencil in place, and the cover is designed to allow wireless charging of the pencil while it is attached. The listing notes that the case can also fit an earlier 11-inch iPad Pro, though the camera cutout is larger on that model. It does not fit other iPad models, so buyers should confirm their device before ordering. The black finish is a practical, low-profile choice for daily use and travel.

record.description: A red double-sided cutting board with a juice groove and non-slip edges. The polypropylene board is nonporous and odor resistant, and it has soft, tapered handles for lifting. It is dishwasher safe.
record.seo_title: OXO Good Grips Red Utility Cutting Board
record.meta_description: OXO Good Grips red utility cutting board, 10.5 by 15 inches, with a juice groove and non-slip edges. Nonporous polypropylene that is dishwasher safe.
record.long_description: The OXO Good Grips utility cutting board is a sturdy kitchen tool made from polypropylene, a nonporous material that resists odors and stains. It measures about 10.5 by 15 inches, a size that handles most chopping tasks without taking up the whole counter. A groove around the board catches juices from meat and fruit so they do not spill onto the counter. The double-sided design means both faces can be used, and the colored edges help distinguish the board from others in a set. Soft, tapered handles make it easy to lift and carry, and the non-slip edges keep the board steady while cutting. The board is safe to wash in the dishwasher, which simplifies cleanup after a busy meal. The red edge is an attractive accent that suits a range of kitchen styles.

record.description: A set of six battery-operated LED votive candles with a flickering warm light. A remote with timer function controls them, and batteries are included. The unscented candles suit parties, weddings, and home decor.
record.seo_title: Candle Choice 6 Battery LED Votives with Remote
record.meta_description: Candle Choice six battery-operated LED votive candles with flickering warm light, remote timer, and batteries included. Suited to parties and weddings.
record.long_description: These flameless votive candles give a warm, flickering glow without an open flame, making them practical for homes, party tables, and events where real candles are not allowed. The set includes six small LED candles that run on batteries, which are included with the package. A remote control allows the user to switch the candles on and off and to set a timer, so they can run on a schedule without being checked. The flicker mimics the movement of real wax candles, and the warm white light suits centerpieces, mantels, and dining tables. The unscented design means the candles will not interfere with food or fragrance in a room. The listing suggests use for weddings, baptisms, holidays, and kitchen decor. Keep the candles away from children who may try to swallow the batteries, and check the battery compartment periodically to replace batteries as needed.

record.description: Small yellow gold plated sterling silver hoop earrings, 20 millimeters across, with a thin 1 mm profile. The hypoallergenic design uses a reinforced hoop. The earrings suit everyday wear and layered looks.
record.seo_title: Carleen 14K Gold Plated Silver Hoop Earrings 20mm
record.meta_description: Carleen 14K gold plated sterling silver hoop earrings, 20 mm, hypoallergenic with a thin 1 mm profile. Dainty everyday earrings for women and girls.
record.long_description: These hoop earrings are finished with a 14K gold plating over sterling silver, giving a bright yellow gold look for everyday wear. Each hoop measures about 20 millimeters across and is 1 millimeter thick, a dainty profile that sits close to the ear. The listing describes a reinforced hoop, with an additional loop of gold for strength, and a hypoallergenic design meant for sensitive ears. The earrings have a secure hinge-free closure that the seller suggests is easy to put on and take off. They pair well with other small earrings for a layered look, and they work with both casual and dressy outfits. Carleen, a family owned jewelry company based in New York, offers an exchange policy and a return window for buyers who are not satisfied. Store the earrings in a dry pouch to protect the plating from scratches and tarnish.

record.description: A collapsible play tunnel for hamsters, guinea pigs, mice, and rats. It includes three connected tunnels in a long and short size, made from cotton and polyester fabric. It gives small pets space to run, explore, and hide.
record.seo_title: Rypet Collapsible Small Animal Play Tunnel
record.meta_description: Rypet collapsible small animal play tunnel with three connected tunnels in cotton and polyester. For hamsters, guinea pigs, mice, and rats.
record.long_description: This play tunnel gives hamsters, guinea pigs, mice, and rats a fabric path to explore and hide in during the day. The set has three connected tunnels, with a long tunnel of about 11.4 inches and a shorter tunnel of about four inches, so several pets can play at once. The walls are made from a cotton upper and a polyester filament lining that the seller describes as high quality and durable. Because the tunnel collapses, it is easy to store between play sessions or to clean when it gets soiled. Exercise is important for small pets, and a tunnel gives them a place to run back and forth, climb, and rest in shade. Choose a spot away from drafts and heaters, and wash the fabric by hand with mild soap when it needs cleaning. Watch for signs of chewing and replace the tunnel if the fabric is damaged.

record.description: A blue Los Angeles Dodgers themed bat and ball set made by Rawlings. The MLB-branded set comes in a package about 62 centimeters long. It is sporting goods suited to play or collecting.
record.seo_title: Rawlings MLB Dodgers Grandslam Bat and Ball
record.meta_description: Rawlings MLB Los Angeles Dodgers Grandslam bat and ball set in blue. A team-themed sporting goods set for play, display, or fan gifts.
record.long_description: This Grandslam bat and ball set brings the colors of the Los Angeles Dodgers into a sporting goods product that suits play, display, or collecting. The bat and ball are finished in blue with team styling and are sold together as a set. The package measures about 62 centimeters long, 5 centimeters wide, and 7.6 centimeters high, which makes it easy to store on a shelf or in a sports bag. Rawlings is a well known name in baseball equipment, and this set is positioned as a fan gift for children and adults who follow the team. The bat is a lightweight option for casual swings and practice in the yard. Keep the bat dry and store it away from extreme heat to protect the finish. Check local rules before using the set in organized leagues, since some equipment is designed for display rather than competitive play.

record.description: Cycling shoes with SPD and Delta cleat compatibility for lock pedal bikes, including Peloton bikes. They offer a structured sole and support around the heel for riding. The shoes come in black with yellow accents.
record.seo_title: FEETCITY Cycling Shoes SPD Delta Black Yellow
record.meta_description: FEETCITY cycling shoes in black and yellow with SPD and Delta cleat compatibility for Peloton and lock pedal bikes. Structured sole and heel support.
record.long_description: These cycling shoes are built for riders who use lock pedals, including the SPD and Delta cleat systems that fit many indoor and outdoor bikes. The listing names Peloton compatibility, which makes the shoes a fit for home spin and cycling users who want a secure connection to the pedal. The sole is structured to help transfer power on the pedal stroke, and the heel cup offers support to reduce slipping during climbs and sprints. The fit is described as generous with good arch support, so riders can add a sock or an insert if needed. The black upper has yellow accents that give the shoe a sporty look. Cleats are sometimes sold separately, and the seller notes that a delta cleat is included with some listings, so check the contents before purchase. Adjust cleat position and tension carefully on first use, and wear the shoes for short rides to build comfort.

record.description: An ergonomic office chair in pink lemonade with a 100% polyester seat. It includes adjustable seat depth, arms, height, and recline tension along with a mesh back. The chair has casters suited to carpeted floors.
record.seo_title: Steelcase Series 2 Office Chair Pink Lemonade
record.meta_description: Steelcase Series 2 office chair in pink lemonade with adjustable seat depth, arms, and recline tension, a mesh back, and carpet casters.
record.long_description: The Steelcase Series 2 is an office chair that combines a flexible seat with a mesh back for airflow during long days at a desk. The pink lemonade upholstery is 100 percent polyester, a fabric chosen for durability and easy care. Users can adjust the seat depth, the height, the arms, and the recline tension to fit their posture and their work style. A flexing back supports the spine as the user moves, and the seat is upholstered for comfort. The black base and frame keep the chair grounded visually while the seat adds color to a workspace. Casters are designed for carpeted floors, which helps the chair glide without damaging the surface. Set up the chair with the feet flat, the back supported, and the armrests at a height that keeps the shoulders relaxed. Revisit the adjustments periodically, since the best settings can change over time.

record.description: A full-body thin wetsuit style rash guard in black and blue, sized large for women. It offers full-body and long-sleeve UV protection suited to diving, snorkeling, surfing, and kayaking. The one-piece suit is designed for active water sports.
record.seo_title: COPOZZ Full Body Rash Guard Diving Skin Large
record.meta_description: COPOZZ full-body diving skin in black and blue, large for women. Thin wetsuit fabric with UV protection for snorkeling, surfing, and kayaking.
record.long_description: This diving skin is a full-body thin wetsuit style suit that covers the arms, legs, and torso to provide sun and water protection. The listing describes full-body UV protection, which suits long sessions in open water or on sunny beaches. The suit is designed for activities such as diving, snorkeling, surfing, wake boarding, kayaking, and white water rafting. The black and blue colorway is classic for water sports. Sizing is labeled large for women, so buyers should check the size chart against their measurements before ordering. The one-piece build reduces gaps where water can enter, and the fabric is meant to stay comfortable when wet. Rinse the suit in fresh water after each use and dry it in the shade to keep the material in good condition.

record.description: A pair of pink elastic mask extender straps that take pressure off the ears from wearing a face mask. They are adjustable and can hold a mask around the neck when not in use. The straps suit men, women, and kids.
record.seo_title: Muryobao Pink Mask Extender Strap 2 Pack
record.meta_description: Muryobao pink elastic face mask extender straps, two-pack. Relieve ear pressure and keep masks around the neck. Adjustable for men, women, and kids.
record.long_description: These mask extenders are elastic lanyards with hooks that attach to the ends of a face mask, moving the pull point from the ears to the back of the head. The listing states the hooks measure about 12 centimeters, or 4.7 inches, and the elastic stretches well beyond its resting length. This design helps reduce the ache and pressure that can build up behind the ears during long periods of mask wear.
